subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should this issue be resolved by keeping Himalaya bundled and fixing its core skill docs, or by letting the protected bundled-skill trim remove/externalize Himalaya from core?
rationale: Current main still exposes stale bundled docs, but the active protected PR changes the product boundary for optional skills; automation cannot safely choose whether to patch or remove the core surface.

options.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor decide whether Himalaya leaves core, then close this issue if the bundled skill is removed or patch docs if it remains.

options.title: Patch Bundled Docs Now
options.body: If maintainers want Himalaya to stay bundled for this release, land a focused docs repair with verified Himalaya version scope and correct pimalaya save-copy reference.

options.title: Move To ClawHub Package
options.body: If Himalaya should live outside core but not through the current trim PR, publish or point users to an external skill/bundle package with verified docs and smoke proof.

recommendation.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
recommendation.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor decide whether Himalaya leaves core, then close this issue if the bundled skill is removed or patch docs if it remains.

likelyOwner.reason: fuller-stack-dev owns the open PR that currently decides whether Himalaya remains in the bundled core skill set.
